title: Head Tracking DJI O3 Air Unit
description: A 2-axis head tracking system for the DJI Goggles 3 and O3 air unit using an MPU module and ESP32 C3 Superminis.

assets.description: Goggles-side ESP32: MPU6050 DMP, auto-calibration, ESP-NOW secure packet transmit (yaw + pitch)

assets.description: Drone-side ESP32: ESP-NOW receive, checksum validation, exponential smoothing, pan/tilt servo control with failsafe recentering
